query:
SELECT id, empresaSlug, nome, cargo, exibirNoRanking, ativo, cashbarberProfissionalId, categoriaRanking, metaMensal
FROM colaboradores 
WHERE empresaSlug LIKE '%mascote%' OR empresaSlug LIKE '%Mascote%'
ORDER BY empresaSlug, nome;
